commentReplyMode.privateDesc: Jawab24 will send a private message using Smart Replies. No comment reply.

replyModeDescription: Reply on the comment or via private message
dualReplyDesc: Short comment reply + full private message

dualReplyConfigHelper: Max 80 characters • No links • Keep it short

businessHours.flowDesc: Auto-reply is active during business hours. Outside these hours, an away message is sent.

awayMessageConnectedDesc: Sent to customers outside work hours or when auto-reply is off
awayMessageDefault: Thanks for your message! We're currently away and will get back to you as soon as possible.

reminders.title: Reply Reminders
reminders.desc: Get notified when comments or messages haven't been replied to
reminders.helpText: Set how long to wait before sending a reminder

replyDelay.title: Reply Delay
replyDelay.desc: A short pause before each reply makes it feel more human
replyDelay.tip: We recommend 2-5 seconds for the most natural feel
replyDelay.example: The actual wait varies slightly each time so it feels natural
replyDelay.formula: Each reply waits between half and 1.5× your set time

greetingMessage.title: First Message to New Customers
greetingMessage.desc: Sent when a customer messages you for the first time

awayMessage.title: After-Hours Message
awayMessage.desc: Sent when customers message outside business hours
